hooks.text: 四键极简操作既可挑战闪电反应，也能切到有限步数的战术玩法
hooks.excerpt: Find your flow to test your lightning reflexes, or play it tactical with limited moves. With a minimalist 4-button setup, there are no excuses!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 主题不只是换皮，每个主题都自带专属强化并改变每局打法
hooks.excerpt: Themes aren’t just for looks. Each one has its own special power-up, giving you fun new ways to play and shake up every run.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 负面诅咒可能藏着强化收益，但选错会直接把进度打回第一轮
hooks.excerpt: Do not underestimate maluses as they can provide hidden power-ups along the way, but the wrong one could spell an early repeat to round one.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 视觉表现优秀且风格鲜明。
激光与闪电效果非常有冲击力。

excerpts.excerpt: the lasers and lightning effects go absolutely hard
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏特效表现极其出色。

excerpts.excerpt: potentially the juiciest game effects ive ever seen in a video game
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: Progression could be improved for smoother runs
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 节奏要求会快速造成手臂疲劳。

excerpts.excerpt: this game will make your arm tired pretty quickly.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 每轮缺乏变强感，只要求更快操作。

excerpts.excerpt: I don't feel stronger with each round I just feel i need to click faster
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期更依赖是否拿到正确卡牌，而非技巧表达。

excerpts.excerpt: later rounds start feeling more like "did you get the right cards" than actual skill expression
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 高强度操作容易导致手部疼痛。

excerpts.excerpt: have to take a break cuze my hand hurts
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏鼓励掌握机制而非无脑按键。

excerpts.excerpt: It rewards mastering its mechanics instead of simply button mashing.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 每次攻击反馈令人满足。
